Media Performance Roles
Trading under Publicis Media Australia
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Performance Media Executive (also known as Performance Executive, Digital Activation Executive, Paid Search Executive, Senior Performance Executive, Senior Performance Media Executive, Senior Digital Activation Executive, Digital Activation Senior Executive)
 
Role Overview  
The purpose of the Performance Media Executive is to assist in the implementation and management of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers. This role exists to support the Performance Media team across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation. 
  
Skills & Experience 
•	This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.  
•	Supporting Account Managers and Directors across the team to deliver across account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copy-writing, quality-checks and best practice 
•	Own campaign execution in support to your Account Manager and Director, delivery and execution of a given customer campaign and/or account 
•	Assist in the development of insights for reporting, laddering up to the ‘so-what?’  
•	Own the building of new Search, Programmatic, Social campaign accounts ensuring a high level of detail is observed and we are aligned to the customer brief. 
•	Own the loading of monthly budgets and management of budget pacing through the month with Performance Media Coordinators. 
•	Own in the loading of proposed budgets into our invoicing system accurately and reconciling budgets on a monthly basis.  
•	Identify areas for account improvement and feed-back to Performance Media Managers and Directors and into Coordinators. 
•	Basic-Intermediate (12-24 months minimum) understanding and working knowledge of either SEM, Paid Social or Programmatic campaign build and/or management. 
•	Basic-Intermediate (6-24 months) understanding of Google or Adobe Analytics 
•	Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel  
•	Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint and Outlook) 

Salary: $80K - $90K package 


Performance Manager (Also known as Performance Media Manager, Associate Activation Manager, Digital Activation Manager, Paid Search Manager, Search Manager, Associate Performance Director)

The purpose of the Performance Media Account Manager is to manage the delivery of industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers/clients.
This role exists to deliver, with the support of the wider Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers.
Managing responsibilities of Executives and/or Coordinators to ensure account deliverables including reporting, optimisation tactics, copywriting, quality-checks and best practice. This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Excellent ability to analyse and manipulate data, extracting insights for reporting.
Salary: $85K - $115K package

Performance Director (Also known as Performance Media Director, Associate Activation Director, Digital Activation Director, Senior Search Manager, Search Director
The purpose of the Performance Director is to define industry-leading Performance Media strategies for our customers and also responsible for ensuring the best possible ROI for a client’s digital/performance media investment. This role exists to deliver, with the Performance Media team, across (but not limited to) Search Engine Marketing, Programmatic, Video, Social and Mobile channels and platforms delivering accurate and timely reports, optimisation implementation that drives business outcomes for our customers/clients. Own the mid to senior customer relationship to ensure we are aligned with the customer and delivering on their business needs. Full responsibility for people management and account management/implementation within your team, and ensuring campaigns deliver against client KPIs. Responding to and presenting new business pitches.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Excellent understanding and working knowledge of Performance marketing, backed by relevant experience. Good understanding and working knowledge of Australian media landscape. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Leadership and mentoring of performance digital teams.
Salary – Over threshold

(3 Positions)
Target Business Services
Location: 61 Clifford Street, Maddington WA 6109 
Salary: $80,000 plus 12% superannuation
 
Our client Convenience Marketing Solutions Pty Ltd trading as Shikha Transport has been at the forefront of Western Australia’s heavy transport sector — has a story of growth, innovation and an unwavering commitment to clients’ success. The  vision is to be the most trusted and efficient bulk-haulage partner for the resources and agricultural sectors in WA, delivering every load safely, on time, and with the utmost professionalism. 

Shikha Transport operates a modern fleet including quad and super-quad trailer combinations to optimise payload and reduce vehicle movements. The services cover large-scale movement of iron ore, nickel, grain, sand and other essential raw materials, shuttle runs from mine sites to processing plants and ports, and timely agricultural haulage during peak harvest seasons. We provide integrated, end-to-end logistics solutions tailored to mining, construction and farming clients.

Shikha Transport is seeking full-time Truck Drivers experienced in heavy/bulk haulage to join its Maddington operations. These roles are vital to safely and efficiently moving high-volume bulk and palletised freight across WA, supporting production schedules, port transfers and construction/agricultural supply chains.

Essential requirements
-	AQF Certificate II or III in Driving Operations, or equivalent heavy vehicle qualification.
-	Minimum one year full-time experience in bulk haulage, multi-combination or heavy vehicle operations.
-	Valid MC (Multi Combination) driver licence (or applicable heavy vehicle licence for combination vehicles) with a clean driving history.
-	Demonstrated ability to safely operate quad / super-quad trailers and manage high-payload loads.
-	Familiarity with GPS, electronic logbook systems and modern fleet telematics.
-	Willingness to work flexible hours, including shift work, nights and occasional regional travel.

Key responsibilities are set out below: 

-	Safely operate heavy vehicles including quad and super-quad trailer combinations for bulk and palletised freight.
-	Perform shuttle runs, port transfers, site deliveries and bulk haulage for mining, agricultural and construction customers.
-	Load and unload cargo using appropriate equipment; secure loads in accordance with load-restraint requirements.
-	Conduct accurate pre-trip and post-trip inspections and complete vehicle defect reporting.
-	Maintain required driving and shift records (work diaries / electronic logbooks), fuel and mileage records.
-	Adhere to fatigue management rules, heavy vehicle regulations and Chain of Responsibility obligations.
-	Communicate proactively with dispatch and site personnel regarding ETAs, delays and site requirements.
-	Report vehicle faults and coordinate routine maintenance; assist with minor on-road repairs where safe and appropriate.
-	Uphold high standards of customer service and professional conduct at client sites.
-	Comply with site specific induction, safety and environmental protocols (PPE, permit to work, site inductions). 

Applications for this opportunity should be forwarded by email to: recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au 

Please note only short-listed candidates will be contacted and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

Best Day Ever Group Pty Ltd is seeking a qualified and experienced Chef to join our dynamic kitchen team on a full-time basis. This is an excellent opportunity for a passionate hospitality professional to contribute to a fast-paced and customer-focused environment.

Position: Chef (Full-Time)

Salary: $77,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

Key Responsibilities

•	Prepare and cook high-quality meals in accordance with established recipes and presentation standards.
•	Assist in the development and planning of menus, including seasonal and special offerings.
•	Monitor food quality throughout preparation and service to ensure consistency and customer satisfaction.
•	Manage food stock levels and assist with ordering supplies to maintain efficient kitchen operations.
•	Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and workplace health and safety regulations.
•	Minimise food wastage through effective stock rotation and inventory management practices.
•	Work collaboratively with kitchen and front-of-house staff to ensure smooth service delivery.
•	Train and mentor junior kitchen staff as required.

Essential Requirements

•	Ability to maintain high standards of food quality and presentation.

Desirable Attributes
•	Creative approach to menu development and food presentation.
•	Leadership skills with the ability to supervise and support junior staff.
•	Commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
•	Flexibility to work weekends, public holidays, and varied shifts as required.

If you meet the above requirements and are looking for an exciting opportunity within a growing hospitality business, we encourage you to apply.

Location: Darwin. Northern Territory
Employment Type: Full-time

ABOUT US
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYER
We are supporting a hospitality group (SXW Pty Ltd) based in Darwin that operates across several popular venues, specialising in Aussie-Italian and Aussie-Filipino fusion cuisine. The business is known for it's commitment to handcrafted meals, warm service, and consistent customer satisfaction. They are currently hiring for the following role: Kitchenhand. These roles offer a great opportunity to join a dynamic team and grow within a stable, fast-paced hospitality environment.

KITCHEN HAND
Job Overview:
The Kitchen Hand supports the kitchen team by maintaining hygiene standards, assisting with food prep, and ensuring clean and safe kitchen operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Wash dishes, kitchen equipment, and surfaces
Assist in basic food preparation.
Manage garbage disposal and restocking.
Comply with food safety and hygiene regulations.

Requirements:
Experience in a kitchen environment preferred.
Reliability, physical stamina, and attention to detail.
Ability to follow instructions and maintain standards.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS
Competitive salary starting at $67,510 (with scope to increase based on experience)
Opportunities for internal advancement and skills training
Positive, inclusive work environment

Non-monetary benefits may include staff meals 
*Salary ranges for eligible roles may reach up to $75,000 depending on skills, responsibilities and experience.

Alandale Produce is a well-established commercial farming business located in White Rock, NSW. We operate over 150 acres of farmland producing premium quality lettuce, cauliflower, cabbage, leek, potatoes and sweet corn. We supply fresh produce to wholesale markets throughout New South Wales seven days a week.

We are seeking a reliable and experienced Truck Driver to join our team on a full-time basis.

About the Role

Reporting to the Farm Manager, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transportation of fresh produce from our farm to wholesale markets and distribution centres while ensuring compliance with all road transport and food safety requirements.

•	Drive rigid or heavy vehicles to transport fresh produce to wholesale markets and customers. 
•	Load, secure and unload produce safely to prevent damage during transit. 
•	Conduct daily pre-start and post-trip vehicle inspections. 
•	Maintain vehicle logbooks and delivery documentation. 
•	Ensure compliance with Heavy Vehicle National Law (HVNL), Chain of Responsibility (CoR) and road safety regulations. 
•	Monitor refrigerated vehicles where applicable to maintain product quality. 
•	Perform basic vehicle maintenance checks and promptly report faults. 
•	Assist with loading activities using appropriate manual handling techniques and equipment. 
•	Communicate with farm staff, market personnel and customers regarding delivery schedules. 
•	Maintain cleanliness and presentation of the vehicle. 
•	Follow workplace health and safety procedures at all times. 
•	Work flexible hours, including early morning starts, weekends and public holidays during peak harvest periods. 

Essential Requirements

•	Current Australian HR or HC Driver Licence. 
•	Minimum two years' truck driving experience. 
•	Good knowledge of NSW road network and regional delivery routes. 
•	Strong commitment to workplace safety. 
•	Excellent time management and organisational skills. 
•	Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. 
•	Physically fit and capable of loading and unloading produce when required. 
•	Good communication skills. 
•	Reliable, punctual and honest. 

Desirable

•	Forklift Licence. 
•	Experience transporting fresh produce or agricultural products. 
•	Knowledge of refrigerated transport operations. 
•	Basic mechanical knowledge. 

What We Offer

•	Full-time permanent position. 
•	Annual salary of $80,000 plus Superannuation. 
•	Stable long-term employment. 
•	Supportive family-owned business. 
•	Opportunity to work within a successful agricultural operation. 
•	Regional lifestyle in the Central Tablelands of NSW.

result.description:
Colormaker Industries Australia is a well-established, family-owned manufacturer of quality coatings for interior and exterior application. Amongst a broad range of technologies, Colormaker also manufactures and exports market leading world class products in textile screen printing inks and high solids epoxy swimming pool coatings. The business is based on Sydney’s Northern Beaches.

We require a dedicated coatings & inks Quality Control (QC) Chemist to join our busy team of specialists in Brookvale, NSW.

Reporting to the Senior Chemist and Technical Manager, the duties and responsibilities of the role will include:

. Performing laboratory tests/QC procedures on paints and raw materials and recommending improvements for Factory Production and Product Development
. Preparing materials for test and/or experimentation
. Performing calculations, computations and measurements
. Analyzing test data results and preparing relevant reviews, reports and summaries
. Auditing and controlling the quality and quantity of materials used in QC tests, R&D and product maintenance
. Checking, calibrating and maintaining test equipment and other laboratory facilities
. Management of Safety Data Sheets, both Raw Materials and Finished Goods
. Technical and other support to Customer Service and Marketing, including translation of technical and other product literature
. Proficient use of Tencia/Arrow, Color I Control and relevant business software (including MS EXCEL). Also use of company systems
. Maintenance of relevant QC and Production records and related administration
. Adhering to appropriate workplace health and safety standards and making recommendations for improvement
. Management of Hazardous Materials and Dangerous Goods.
. Advising and sourcing materials for Research and Development (R&D) projects
. Carrying out product development work on new and existing products

We offer a competitive remuneration package of between $70,000 to $85,000 per annum, excluding superannuation.

The successful candidate will have either:

. A relevant AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma plus five (5) years’ work experience; or
. At least ten (10) years of relevant full-time work experience

The successful candidate must have coatings experience. In particular, high solids epoxy, high performance industrial surface coatings, broad wall architectural and construction membranes etc would be highly regarded, as would knowledge of textile and other screen printing ink technologies. They must also be passionate about the environment, have a good eye for colour and for detail as well as an ability to work with minimal supervision. A high degree of numeracy and literacy in English are mandatory, whilst technical fluency in European languages would be highly regarded.  Applicants must have full and permanent working rights in Australia to be considered.

If you feel that you are suited to the role of Quality Control Chemist, then please send your CV to us via email technical@colormaker.com.au.
